Population increased in Rochford

The estimated population of Rochford in 2024 was 89,815 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Rochford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Rochford increased by 4.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Rochford was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Rochford

The average (median) age fell to 44.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Rochford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Rochford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Rochford's population of 89,815 usual residents was made up of:

  • 15,910 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.7%)
  • 53,155 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.2%)
  • 20,750 people aged 65 years and over, (23.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Rochford has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Rochford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Rochford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Rochford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 114 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 814 births and 928 deaths in Rochford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,003 (1.1%). There were 5,131 people entering the area and 4,128 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Rochford's population of 363 (0.4%) as a result of 442 people entering the area and 79 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Rochford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Rochford in mid-2023 is 88,560.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 164 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 208 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 372 people.
